updates.title_zh: CME Expands Crypto Futures Lineup With Bitcoin Cash and Uniswap
updates.title_en: CME Expands Crypto Futures Lineup With Bitcoin Cash and Uniswap
updates.what_changed_zh: CME计划于10月19日推出比特币现金和Uniswap期货，有待监管审查；公布合约规格，并披露其加密衍生品上半年日均成交27.98万份合约、名义价值83亿美元。
updates.what_changed_en: CME plans to launch Bitcoin Cash and Uniswap futures on October 19, pending regulatory review; disclosed contract sizes and that its crypto derivatives averaged 279,800 contracts daily in H1 2026, worth $8.3 billion in notional volume.
